about: Issue 1877: Acid Thorns, the Chorus close-in weapon (rules id tendril: range 1, 2 shots, acid), built in Blender (fx/munition_bodies/chorus_bolt.glb, fx/fx_acid_thorn.gd). The Spitter (the Chorus destroyer that carries it) fires its two thorns at a Directorate destroyer one hex away, as a clip (every frame saved): the gland swells, the thorns fly point first, stick in the plating, acid sheets down and pools, then each thorn crumbles. Run with --part moments --moments res://bench/look_moments_acid_thorn.json.

rows.label: Acid Thorns (built thorn, sticks then crumbles)
